config_name: iPad Pro 13-inch (M4 clearance) — M4 (9-core CPU/10-core GPU), 12GB RAM, 256GB SSD, 13" Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED + Magic Keyboard

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard included in price (same M4/M5-compatible keyboard): scissor keys (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge

battery.notes: Apple claims 10h web/video on Wi-Fi. Same cell as M5; users report ~8-9h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: BBY clearance sale $1,889.99 (reg $2,099.99; BBY 17975229, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard 13" $449.99 (BBY 17932868, M4/M5-compatible). Sale price used; clearance stock only. Apple Pencil Pro $168.99 not included.

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 1889.99 + keyboard per price.notes.

reviews.quote: A tablet that knows almost only superlatives.
An exceptional tablet. Its vivid OLED display is a marvel.
A five-star triumph — the best tablet Apple has ever made.

praises: At $1,889.99 clearance it's the cheapest way into the tandem OLED 13" Pro — same display and chassis as the M5 (r/ipad deal threads)
M4 is still faster than nearly every Windows tablet and most ultrabooks in daily use; the M5 gap only shows in GPU-heavy benchmarks
Same Magic Keyboard and Pencil Pro compatibility as M5 — accessories carry forward
Impossibly thin (~5.1mm) and light for a 13"
complaints: iPadOS is the bottleneck regardless of chip: no full desktop-class apps, file management friction
Wi-Fi 6E vs M5's Wi-Fi 7 and no on-device AI speed uplift — buyers report feeling the generational gap in Apple Intelligence tasks
Clearance units are last-of-stock; check warranty start date and remaining AppleCare eligibility
Magic Keyboard at $449.99 with unlit keys is still full accessory price on a discounted tablet
12GB RAM caps the heaviest pro apps, same as the M5 256GB tier

design_philosophy: The 2024 M4 Pro introduced the tandem OLED and this exact chassis — the M5 refresh kept the body and upgraded the engine. At $1,889.99 Best Buy clearance the M4 is today's notable value pick in the Pro line: identical display, keyboard, and pen ecosystem for $210 less than M5, with only chip-generation and Wi-Fi 7 differences. Clearance stock is finite, which is part of the deal.
rating_notes: Pro scores from NBC/Tom's Guide/What Hi-Fi M4 13" reviews (gap-fill 2026-11-25); ratings cross-checked against the 13" M5 256GB anchor (see SHARED-ipad-pro.md). M4 vs M5 deltas per SHARED note: −0.3 productivity, −0.3 creative_work, −0.5 ai_ml (weaker NPU/GPU, no Wi-Fi 7); battery/display/keyboard identical (same chassis and Magic Keyboard). Ecosystem 6.5 (~9 casual/creative, ~5-6 desktop-app parity). Battery 8.0 on ~8.5h real use. Upgradability 1.0: everything soldered.
